shots.prompt: Atomic shot 3 of 6, two-second hypersonic projectile flight, native sound effects. Preserve the same ruined arena, black-robed fighter silhouette, armored enemy and one coherent blue-orange lotus. START STATE: the lotus has just left the fighter and the enemy is distant on the right. END STATE: the lotus stops a hand-width before the enemy's golden shield, with the target now large and readable in frame. The only change is rapid left-to-right travel across distance. Camera dives behind and slightly beside the lotus with aggressive parallax and a speed ramp; twin flame trails form a tight helix, pressure rings kick dust sideways and crack a moving line through the ground. MUST SHOW the target growing quickly in frame and actively bracing. Do not make contact, do not crack the shield, do not detonate, do not spawn extra projectiles, no internal cuts, no dialogue, no music, no subtitles, no text, no watermark. Audio only: violent rushing flame, rising sub-bass pressure and two short sonic booms, cutting to near-silence just before contact.
